patch_description: Replace the linear CZ chain with a brick-layer entanglement pattern. The seed ansatz uses CZ gates in a line (0-1, 1-2, ..., 6-7), which means qubits 0 and 7 are 7 hops apart. The brick-layer pattern uses two staggered sets of CZ pairs: even (0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6-7) and odd (1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-0), with RY rotations between them. This creates a ring topology where any two qubits are at most 2 entangling layers apart. Combined with data re-uploading (l=3) and p=2 repetitions, this provides rich entanglement with the same parameter budget. The RZ final layer is retained for phase control.
